notes.title: Minoria, the spiritual sequel to Momodora, is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce that my latest project, Minoria, is now finally out on Steam!

If you are unfamiliar with the game, Minoria is a sidescroller that follows very closely the gameplay and atmosphere foundations I set with Momodora: RUtM. And, on top of those foundations, I've built a new setting filled with characters fighting for their own goals and beliefs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/610a9444be68692f3e0ccc0537e510166dffdeb3.jpg[/img]


You can check the store page here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/940910/Minoria

Cheers!

notes.title: Minoria, the spiritual sequel to Momodora, arrives on August 27th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm here with big news regarding Minoria, the spiritual sequel to the Momodora games I've been working on.
We've released a new trailer for the game today, revealing the release date for the game: August 27th!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/610a9444be68692f3e0ccc0537e510166dffdeb3.jpg[/img]

If you are unfamiliar with the project, Minoria is a sidescroller that follows very closely the gameplay and atmosphere foundations I set with Momodora: RUtM. And, on top of those foundations, I've built a new setting filled with characters fighting for their own goals and beliefs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/beeb251800d09eda229551236aa965c2e735ec7b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/e098e4c053da57f93f07fd34f712a28661b320d2.png[/img]

You might also be interested in checking the game's store page, where you can find more information:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/940910/Minoria/


I hope you are as excited as I am for the release of this game!
Cheers!

notes.title: Momodora Spiritual Sequel coming out soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I've come to share some exciting news about Minoria, the project I'm currently directing.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/9f60cd3c874146b28f4ef618ab795d0e399f51bd.png[/img]

Minoria is a sidescroller that follows very closely the gameplay and atmosphere foundations I set with Momodora: RUtM, and as such I consider it a spiritual sequel to that game. And, on top of those foundations, I've built a new setting filled with characters fighting for their own goals and beliefs.


[url=https://t.co/NVIvZBGCB8]Click here for the game's store page, where we have a new trailer and new screenshots![/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11978475/cc9949c6227d05db1a05305d9a128d23b0414737.png[/img]

I am actually finishing up work on the game together with the rest of the Bombservice team. We've got everyone who worked on the Momodora games together, plus some new names.

I hope you will look forward to the full release of Minoria! Thank you!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/940910/Minoria/

notes.title: A new Momodora game is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
We have some exciting news for you: this Friday, March 4th, a new Momodora game will be released!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/428550/]Here's the store page for it![/url]

[img=http://puu.sh/npYLv/acfe064a57.png][/img]

This new entry in the series, Reverie Under the Moonlight, is a prequel to the previously released games. You can find more on the store page linked above!

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: v. 1.11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I uploaded a new version of Momodora 3, fixing a few odd bugs. It also improved the way the ranged attack works!

Changelog (version 1.11)
-Fixed a bug related to cancelling the character selection after selecting the character.
-Fixed a bug that prevented you from doing anything if you tried configuring controls twice in a row.
-Fixed a bug which prevented you from releasing the charged paper seal if you mashed attack.

notes.title: v. 1.10
notes.notes:
Changelog:

-Added a new difficulty mode, called "Casual". Hopefully more players can benefit from this, diminishing their frustration!
Note: you need to start a new save file to select this difficulty.

-Easy mode now starts with 5 hearts again.

-Momo/Dora keep their differences related to dialogue and the shop placement for Dora at the first stage. The "Dream Ring" which Dora started with was transfered to Easy mode.

notes.title: Quick update and announcement
notes.notes:
Hello there! It's been a while.
I uploaded a quick update that allows you to remap your keyboard keys!

Anyway, onto exciting matters!
We've been at work on a new game, Momodora IV!
Check out the progress and current work at: http://momodora4.tumblr.com/

notes.title: Steam Cards + v. 1.08
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Here's a new version of the game,

Changelog v. 1.08
-added steam cards!
-adjusted some things. bosses in general do more damage now, and have more hp
-ladybugs now drop less money and have a rarer chance to spawn the golden variant
-easy mode now starts with 4 hearts
-renamed easy mode
-changed the game's description on the store page!
-fixed a graphical bug related to being cursed as a bunny
-fixed some typos

notes.title: version 1.06
notes.notes:
Changelog:
-fixed a bug which didn't reset the ghost helper's state
-fixed a bunch of bugs related to the extra boss fight
-fixed a typo in ceremonial fabric's item description. it's actually "attack +400%"!
-fixed a bug which allowed you to get to a room you died in from another save file
-fixed a bug in arabella sisters boss fight
-made it so mariel disappears from her usual locations if the timer is past 30 minutes
-made it so you can manage inventory items while next to a save point without triggering the save point dialogue

That's it, for now. Steam Cards will be out soon, I hope!

notes.title: version 1.04
notes.notes:
Version 1.04 is out! Here's the changelog:

-fixed a bug that allowed the ghost helper to kill the third stage boss without actually triggering the fight.
-fixed a bug that allowed you to move during the death animation of the fifth stage boss.
-fixed a bug where the ghost helper gets stuck during the fifth stage boss.
-fixed a bug where an enemy would spawn in the third save point of the sixth stage if you paused the game.
-added an option to return to title screen when you die!
-fixed a bug which allowed you to get the bad ending and still get the good ending at the same time.
-fixed a camera bug when you held down pause/esc during screen transitions
-fixed a bug that could make you go out of bounds during vertical screen transitions
-fixed a tile misplacement that could allow you to go out of bounds in the first map of the fifth stage
-fixed a bug where the second charge of the ranged attack would not come off during its 10 initial frames
-added black borders around the rooms, so it looks less weird when the screen shakes
